blocks.title: Aboriginal Textile Design
blocks.instruction: Complete the notes below. Write ONE WORD ONLY for each answer.
content: - Artists produce craft and learn new techniques
- Initially, artists produced rugs made from {{31}}
- Later artists made batik and screen-printed fabrics
- Designs are linked to traditional beliefs, e.g. some designs are believed to bring {{33}}
- Inspired by the Australian landscape, especially the {{34}}
- Started creating art when he was in {{35}}

- 2001 – designed a 'Journey of a Nation' parade outfit with part of a {{39}} on it
- Exploiting Aboriginal imagery affects the artists and the cultural group, e.g. the {{40}} Case
